description.value: Alpine Inn & Suites is a family-owned motel in Nelson, BC offering 30 newly renovated rooms — from standard queens to full-kitchen family suites and a jacuzzi suite — in a European-style hospitality setting. It sits one minute from downtown Nelson and 20 minutes from Whitewater Ski Resort, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Kootenay region. The variety of room configurations, including suites sleeping up to six guests, suits both solo tourers and small cycling groups.
